questions.question:
**Directions: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. According to his hypothesis, now known as the neuron theory, each nerve cell communicates with others through contiguity rather than continuity.

B. The watershed of all studies of the nervous system was an observation made in 1889 by Spanish scientist Santiago Ramón y Cajal.

C. It has since been proved that Cajal’s theory is not universally true, but his central idea has remained an accurate guiding principle for all further study.

D. That is, communication between adjacent but separate cells must take place across the space and barriers separating them.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'BADC.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence 'B' is independent of any other sentence as it is giving general information about "**an observation by Spanish scientist Santiago Ramón y Cajal**". Hence, 'B' is the first part.
 
• Sentence A will come after B as it is explaining the observation made by the scientist i.e. the neuron theory.
 
• Sentence D will come after A as it is further explaining the neuron theory.
 
• The sentence 'C' is the concluding part because it is talking about the final output of the theory.

 

Paragraph after rearranging the sentences__: *The watershed of all studies of the nervous system was an observation made in 1889 by Spanish scientist Santiago Ramón y Cajal. According to his hypothesis, now known as the neuron theory, each nerve cell communicates with others through contiguity rather than continuity. That is, communication between adjacent but separate cells must take place across the space and barriers separating them. It has since been proved that Cajal’s theory is not universally true, but his central idea has remained an accurate guiding principle for all further study.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a6c2db12945bba9d674d33112fce66b07f00093d75dae93749f9bdb7bd34e7a.png] **__Hint__**

__
 
• Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles__:

 __
 
• Read the sentences attentively and try to comprehend the idea or theme of the sentence and eliminate the irrelevant options.
 
• Try to identify the opening (independent sentence) and closing sentences (concluding sentence).
 
• Try to identify the mandatory pairs. Two sentences can be connected through various connectors and other determinants.

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• वाक्य 'B' किसी अन्य वाक्य से स्वतंत्र है क्योंकि यह "स्पेनिश वैज्ञानिक सैंटियागो रामोन वाई काजल द्वारा एक अवलोकन" के बारे में सामान्य जानकारी दे रहा है। अतः 'B' पहला भाग है।
 
• वाक्य **A**, B के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह वैज्ञानिक द्वारा किए गए अवलोकन यानी न्यूरॉन सिद्धांत की व्याख्या कर रहा है।
 
• वाक्य **D**, A के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह आगे न्यूरॉन सिद्धांत की व्याख्या कर रहा है।
 
• वाक्य 'C' समापन भाग है क्योंकि यह सिद्धांत के अंतिम आउटपुट के बारे में बात कर रहा है।

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • In the given sentence, the past tense form of the verb 'went' is incorrect. • The **verb 'could'** in the given sentence is a **modal verb**. • The **modal verb 'could' is followed by the main verb** and the **main verb also stays in its base form**. • Also, the **main verb that is used with 'could' does not change form according to the subject**. • Therefore, the base form of the verb 'go' should be used in place of the past tense form of the verb 'went'. Hence, the correct answer is option 4. Correct sentence: ***Ranbir could not go** to the award ceremony as he was busy shooting for a film in the Maldives*. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** • दिए गए वाक्य में **क्रिया 'went'** का **भूतकाल रूप गलत है**। • दिए गए वाक्य में **क्रिया 'could'** एक **modal verb** है। • Modal verb 'could' **के बाद मुख्य क्रिया आती है** और **मुख्य क्रिया भी अपने मूल रूप में रहती है**। • साथ ही **जिस मुख्य क्रिया के साथ 'could' प्रयोग किया जाता है**, **वह विषय के अनुसार रूप नहीं बदलता है**। • इसलिए, **भूतकाल क्रिया 'went'** के स्थान पर **मूल रूप क्रिया 'go'** का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए। अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 है। सही वाक्य: *Ranbir could not go to the award ceremony as he was busy shooting for a film in the Maldives*. 30:T1fce, The correct answer is '**was pulled down**.'

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select ‘No substitution’.**

After the old building __was pulled out__, the building contractor surveyed the progress of the work.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**was pulled down**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the underlined segment, the phrasal verb ''pulled out'' is incorrect.
 
• The given sentence is talking about **a contractor surveying** **the progress of the work after** an old building was demolished.
 
• The phrasal verb ''pulled out'' means **(of a vehicle) move out from the side of the road, or from its normal position in order to overtake.**
 
• Therefore, the phrasal verb ''pulled down'' should be used in place of the phrasal verb ''pulled out''.
 
• The phrasal verb ''pulled down'' means demolish a building.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct Sentence: *After the old building **was pulled down**, the building contractor surveyed the progress of the work*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 

__
 
• ''Pulled over'' means **(used about a vehicle or its driver) to slow down and move to the side of the road**. (''Pulled over'' का अर्थ है कार या उसके चालक का गति मंद करते हुए सड़क के किनारे हो जाना)
 
• ''Pulled up'' means **(to cause a car, etc.) to stop**. (''Pulled up'' का अर्थ है कार आदि को रोक देना)

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिए गए रेखांकित खण्ड में phrasal verb ''pulled out'' गलत है।
 
• दिया गया वाक्य **एक पुराने भवन को गिराए जाने के बाद कार्य की प्रगति का सर्वेक्षण करने वाले ठेकेदार के बारे में** बात कर रहा है।
 
• Phrasal verb ''pulled out'' का अर्थ है **कार आदि का सड़क के किनारे से आगे बढ़ जाना**।
 
• इसलिए, phrasal verb ''pulled out'' के स्थान पर phrasal verb ''pulled down'' का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• Phrasal verb ''pulled down'' का अर्थ है **एक इमारत को ध्वस्त करना**।

 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 है।

सही वाक्य: *After the old building was pulled down, the building contractor surveyed the progress of the work*.

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

You can solve this problem.

options.text: This problem can be solved by you.
This problem might be solved by you.
This problem ought to be solved by you.
This problem should be solved by you.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**This problem can be solved by you**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
• The given sentence is in the active voice and it is in the present simple tense.
 
• When we convert this sentence into a passive voice, the subject ''You'' of the active voice becomes the object, the object ''this problem'' becomes the subject.
 
• The active format "V1 (solve)" should be converted into the passive format "be + V3 (solved)".
 
• This is the active and passive voice rule for the present simple tense.
 
• 
 
In general, we follow this **structure to use modal verbs in the passive voice**: **Modal verb + be + past participle**.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

My neighbor was admitted to the hospital when he developed an allergic _______ to some medicine he took.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'reaction.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is talking about an allergy caused by some medicine.
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'reaction'.
 
• The word 'reaction' means **a bad effect that your body experiences because of something that you have eaten, touched, or breathed**. 
 
 
• Example:* He had an allergic **reaction** to something in the food*.

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Complete Sentence: *My neighbor was admitted to the hospital when he developed an allergic **reaction** to some medicine he took*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let us explore the other options:

 
 
• 'Result' means **to happen or exist because of something**. (परिणाम, नतीजा)
 
• 'Retort' means **to reply quickly to what somebody says, in an angry or amusing way**. (चिढ़कर या विनोदी ढंग से किसी की बात का तुरंत जवाब देना)
 
• 'Rejoinder' means **a reply or response to a remark, question, etc., especially one that is quick, funny or critical**. (प्रत्युत्तर विशेषकर परिहासयुक्त टिप्पणी, प्रश्न आदि का)

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य **किसी दवा के कारण होने वाली एलर्जी के बारे में** बात कर रहा है।
 
• इसलिए, रिक्त स्थान में भरने के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द 'reaction' है।
 
• 'Reaction' शब्द का अर्थ है **किसी वस्‍तु को खाने, छूने या सूँघने से शरीर पर पड़ा कुप्रभाव**।
 
 
• उदाहरण: *He had an allergic reaction to something in the food*.
 
 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 है।

पूर्ण वाक्य: *My neighbor was admitted to the hospital when he developed an allergic reaction to some medicine he took*.

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

The professor said to the media persons, “From our research we have come to the conclusion that there is life on that planet.”

options.text: The professor informed the media persons that from our research we have come to the conclusion that there had been life on that planet.
The professor said to the media persons from our research you had come to the conclusion that there was life on that planet.
The professor told the media persons that from their research they had come to the conclusion that there was life on that planet.
The professor told to the media persons that from your research you have come to the conclusion that there is life on that planet.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **The professor told the media persons that from their research they had come to the conclusion that there was life on that planet**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is a direct speech.
 
• The basic rules for changing or converting direct speech into indirect speech:​
 
 
• The commas, inverted commas are removed, and 'that' is added.
 
• The first-person pronoun ''our'' becomes the third-person pronoun ''**their**'', the first-person pronoun ''we'' becomes the third-person pronoun ''they''.
 
• The present perfect tense format 'Subject + have + V3 (come) + Object' will be changed into the past perfect **tense** format '**Subject + had + **V3** (come) + Object**'.
 
• The present simple tense format 'Subject + V1 (is) + Object' will be changed into the past simple tense format 'Subject + V2 (was) + Object'.**
 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The following table will enable us to know how tense changes into Indirect speech:-
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Direct Speech
 Indirect Speech
 
 

 Present simple (Subject +V1st + Object)
 Past simple (Subject +V2 + Object)
 
 

 Present continuous (Subject +is/am/are+V1 +ing+ Object)
 Past Continuous (Subject +was/were+V1 +ing+ Object)
 
 

 Present perfect (Subject + has/have+V3+Object)
 Past perfect (Subject+had+V3+Object)
 
 

 Past simple (Subject+V2+Object)
 Past perfect (Subject+had+V3+Object)
 
 

 Past Continuous (Subject +was/were+V1+ing+ Object)
 Past perfect continuous (Subject+had been+V1 +ing+ Object)
 
 

 Future simple (Subject+ will/shall+V1+object)
 Present Conditional (Subject+would+V1+object)
 
 

 Future Continuous (Subject +will/shall+be+V1 +ing+ Object)
 Conditional Continuous (Subject +would+be+V1 +ing+ Object)
 
 
 
 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य direct speech है।
 
• Direct speech को indirect speech में बदलने या बदलने के लिए बुनियादी नियम:
 
 
• Commas, inverted commas हटा दिए जाते हैं और 'that' जोड़ा जाता है।
 
• The first-person pronoun ''our'', third-person pronoun ''their**'' बन जाता है, first-person pronoun ''we'' third-person pronoun ''they'' बन जाता है।
 
• Present perfect tense format 'Subject + have + V3 (come) + Object' को past perfect tense format 'Subject + had + V3 (come) + Object' में बदल दिया जाएगा।
 
• Present simple tense format 'Subject + V1 (is) + Object' को past simple tense format 'Subject + V2 (was) + Object' में बदल दिया जाएगा।

 
 
 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 है।

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select ‘No substitution’.**

__The apple a day__ keeps the doctor away.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**An apple a day**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the underlined segment, the noun 'apple' is not a specified noun.

 
 
• The **listener doesn't know what apple you're talking** i.e. **any apple**.
 
 
 
• 'A' and 'an' are indefinite articles, which means that they refer to, or introduce, an unspecified noun.
 
 
• We use 'a' before a consonant sound and we use 'an' before a vowel sound (here, apple).
 
 
 
• The definite article 'the' is used before singular and plural nouns when the noun is specific or particular.
 
• ''No article'' is used when we refer to general ideas, plurals, or uncountable nouns.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct Sentence: ***An apple a day** keeps the doctor away*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

There are three articles: a, an, and the. Articles are used before nouns or noun equivalents and are a type of adjective.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 RULES
 COUNT NOUNS
 NON-COUNT NOUNS
 
 

 Specific identity not known
 a, an
 (no article)
 
 

 Specific identity is known
 the
 the
 
 

 All things or things in general
 (no article)
 (no article)
 
 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• रेखांकित खंड में, संज्ञा 'apple' निर्दिष्ट संज्ञा नहीं है।

 
 
• **श्रोता नहीं जानता** कि आप **किस सेब की बात कर रहे हैं**।
 
 
 
• 'A' और 'an' अनिश्चितकालीन लेख हैं, जिसका अर्थ है कि वे एक अनिर्दिष्ट संज्ञा को संदर्भित करते हैं, या पेश करते हैं।
 
 
• हम एक consonant sound से पहले 'a' का उपयोग करें, और हम एक vowel sound (यहां, apple) से पहले 'an' का उपयोग करें।
 
 
 
• निश्चित लेख 'the' का प्रयोग एकवचन और बहुवचन संज्ञाओं से पहले किया जाता है जब संज्ञा विशिष्ट या विशेष होती है।
 
• जब हम सामान्य विचारों, बहुवचनों या बेशुमार संज्ञाओं का उल्लेख करते हैं तो ''No article'' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

 

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 है।

सही वाक्य: *An apple a day keeps the doctor away*.
